headline: Economist assesses that fuel prices are being maintained amid geopolitical conflict
summary: An economist at the Center of Reform on Economics says the Prabowo-Gibran government has so far been able to maintain fuel prices amid geopolitical conflict. The assessment covers domestic fuel (BBM) pricing.
why: Indonesia subsidises and regulates domestic fuel prices, so government price decisions affect inflation, the budget and energy costs.
